company.name: Avare BioTech
company.shortDescription: Avare BioTech is a biotechnology and animal health tech startup that provides AI-powered tools for reproductive analysis.
company.description: Avare BioTech is a Dubai-based biotechnology and animal health startup specializing in AI-powered reproductive diagnostics for the livestock industry. The company develops innovative mobile semen analysis technologies, including its proprietary MAKSA (Mobile-Assisted Key Semen Analysis) platform, which transforms smartphones and microscopes into portable laboratory-grade diagnostic tools. By leveraging artificial intelligence, computer vision, and cloud-based analytics, Avare BioTech enables veterinarians, breeders, artificial insemination centers, and livestock producers to perform accurate semen quality assessments without relying on expensive traditional CASA laboratory equipment.

productsAndServices.description: A service that analyzes bovine semen quality using AI from smartphone videos, providing motility, concentration, and progressive movement reports within 24 hours.
productsAndServices.name: 24-Hour Bovine Semen Analysis
